sources: dossier=fan-out (silent on expand_folder partition_key content at depth>1); code=lib/services/claim_producers/filesystem/server/server.go::splitExpandFolder#456 (PartitionKey = filepath.ToSlash(relPath), the relative path from the picked folder, not a bare basename)
note: No dossier or corpus artifact specifies expand_folder's child.partition_key content beyond the demoed flat-folder case; code unambiguously sets it to the parent-relative path, which only degenerates to a basename at the default depth=1 (the only case the story's Proof exercises). This is a factual-accuracy fix, not a design fork — rewrote the acceptance clause to name the relative-path behavior and note it collapses to the basename at depth 1.

sources: dossier=permission (Net position: 'an out-of-scope request ... refused with the auth-denied audit row attributing the refusal to scope, not action'; Required behaviors: 'with the audit row attributing refusal to scope rather than action'); code=lib/foundation/auth/audit.go::DenialReason (single undifferentiated DenialPermissionDenied='permission_denied', no scope-vs-action distinction); test=grant_scope_test.go#106 (asserts only denial_reason==permission_denied)
note: The permission dossier states scope-attribution in the audit row as current net position, not a deferred item. Code carries only one denial reason for both scope and action refusals, so the distinction the story's acceptance requires is not mechanically present. Story acceptance wording is correct against intent; the gap is in code. Queued as fix-code, not edited.

sources: dossier=auto-terminal (Required behaviors: 'terminal/error/abandoned is a cascade-firable, subscribable signal'; 'the seven seal/held stories ... each with a scenario proof'); dossier=cascade (held-cascade rule, members/non-members split); dossier=wait-set (wait-set rows are the eligibility ledger tying a receiver's dispatch to its driving sender); test=held_abandon_cascades_abandoned_test.go#93-112 (asserts only settling_signal_type and observer reaching Fresh, no wait-set row or lineage inspection, no pre-abandon non-dispatch assertion)

Queue-only per fix-test; no story edit needed since the prose is accurate.

sources: dossier=host-agent (Required behaviors: 'Agent lifecycle verbs: rimsky agent start/status/stop; stop reaps all spawned children; status truthfully reports connection state, proxy endpoint, and spawned children'); code=cmd/rimsky/cli/agent.go::statusSnapshot#286-290 and runAgentStatus#199-205 (Connected/Proxy/Since only, no children); test=host_agent_control_plane_demo_test.go::TestHostAgentControlPlaneDemo (checks only the literal 'connected' string)
note: Dossier confirms per-run-scope, per-binding children reporting on the status verb as current required behavior, matching the story's acceptance verbatim. cmd/rimsky/cli/agent.go and the writer at lib/control/hostagent/run.go omit children entirely; the demo proof never exercises the clause. Duplicate of an earlier-adjudicated finding (id 89) per the input row; ruling stands independently as required. Queue-only per fix-code; story prose is accurate.

sources: dossier=host-agent-proxy (Conflicts needing human ruling, RESOLVED 2026-07-14: 'executor + claim-producer is the sanctioned late-bind surface ... late-binding a publisher/validation/data-processing service is REJECTED loudly at registration/config; the 2026-06-08 all-five/no-stubs artifact promise is superseded'); dossier=host-agent (Required behaviors line noting the same supersession); code=cmd/rimsky-host-agent-proxy/{publisher_handler.go,validation_handler.go,data_processing_handler.go} (still forward, no rejection wired yet); test=host_agent_latebind_all_protocols_test.go#55-63 (validation/publisher/data_processing + executor subtests, no claim-producer dispatch)
note: The story's entire premise (five late-bindable protocols, no stubs) is superseded by a transcript-tier resolved ruling that narrows the late-bind surface to executor + claim-producer and requires the other three to be refused at registration/config. This outranks the finding's original framing (missing claim-producer e2e proof among five) — the real defect is a stale capability description. Rewrote role/capability/business-value/acceptance/falsifier to the two-protocol surface with explicit rejection of the other three. Note for a later pass: the proxy code and the host-agent-proxy concept doc (concept:host-agent-proxy invariant naming all five protocols) have not yet been updated to enforce/reflect the narrowing — that is a separate fix-code/fix-doc item outside this bundle's file scope.

sources: dossier=run-scope (Required behaviors: 'Late-bound child processes are isolated per run-scope ... concurrent run-scopes never share executor process state'); dossier=host-agent (per-run-scope isolation net position); test=host_agent_per_run_scope_isolation_test.go::TestHostAgentPerRunScopeIsolation#56 (asserts only distinct pids, 177-192; no differential-sibling-reap assertion)

The named proof covers clause 1 (distinct children) but not clauses 2-3 of the falsifier (closing one sibling reaps only its own child). Queue-only per fix-test; story prose is accurate as written.
